title: Structural Characterization of DNA Binding Domain of Essential Mammalian Protein TTF 1
authors: Gajender Singh; Abhinetra Jagdish Bhopale; Saloni Khatri; Prashant Prakash; Rajnish Kumar; Sukh Mahendra Singh; Samarendra Kumar Singh
one_liner_zh: 该文对哺乳动物转录终止因子TTF1的Myb DNA结合域进行同源建模与MD模拟，并结合实验验证其螺旋结构与DNA结合活性，属于TF-DNA互作的结构表征研究，但方法以传统建模为主、AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Transcription termination factor 1 (TTF1), being multifunctional in nature, is involved in a wide range of critical processes that make it essential for survival of the mammalian cells. TTF1 protein comprises three functional domains: the N-terminal (regulatory/inhibitory) domain, trans-activation domain, and C-terminal domain. The Myb domain is responsible for DNA-binding function of this protein and spans 550 to 732 amino acids (183 residues long). Despite the essential role of TTF1 in multiple cellular processes, there is no physical structure available to date. Purification of the functional full-length protein has been unsuccessful so far. Hence, we moved forward towards characterizing the Myb domain of this essential protein. We first constructed a three-dimensional model of the Myb domain using Robetta server and determined its stability through MD simulation in an explicit solvent. To validate the model, upon codon optimization we cloned this domain into a bacterial expression vector. The protein was then purified to homogeneity and its DNA-binding activity was checked by electro-mobility shift assay. We then proceeded to CD spectroscopy and Raman spectroscopy for secondary structure characterization. The results validated the computational model, concluding that this domain is predominantly helical in nature. The confidence built by this study now pushes us to move ahead in order to solve the atomic structure of this critical domain by crystallography or NMR spectroscopy, which in turn will decipher the exact mechanism by which this essential protein engages DNA to cater to various functions.
abstract_zh: 转录终止因子1（TTF1）具有多功能特性，参与多种关键过程，对哺乳动物细胞的生存至关重要。TTF1蛋白包含三个功能域：N端（调控/抑制）域、反式激活域和C端域。Myb域负责该蛋白的DNA结合功能，跨越第550至732位氨基酸（长度为183个残基）。尽管TTF1在多种细胞过程中发挥重要作用，但至今尚无其物理结构。全长功能蛋白的纯化迄今未获成功。因此，我们着手表征这一关键蛋白的Myb域。首先，我们利用Robetta服务器构建了Myb域的三维模型，并通过在显式溶剂中的分子动力学（MD）模拟确定其稳定性。为验证该模型，在密码子优化后，我们将此域克隆至细菌表达载体中。随后，将蛋白纯化至均一状态，并通过电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）检测其DNA结合活性。接着，我们采用圆二色光谱（CD）和拉曼光谱进行二级结构表征。结果验证了计算模型，表明该域本质上以螺旋结构为主。本研究建立的信心推动我们进一步通过晶体学或核磁共振光谱解析这一关键域的原子结构，这将揭示该必需蛋白如何结合DNA以执行多种功能的确切机制。
